name: Toyota Motor Manufacturing Alabama - Huntsville AL

fieldNotes.truckGate: Positively confirmed - a controlled truck checkpoint on the truck lane at the SE side of the property (~34.8278, -86.6360): a marked pinch-point lane with crosswalk-style stripes across the truck lane and a checkpoint structure beside it.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Positively confirmed - a small blue-roofed booth-sized structure (≈1-vehicle footprint) sits directly beside the marked truck-gate lane, with guards' vehicles parked alongside. Classic staffed guard booth.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The gate-to-dock approach runs a long internal road with ample stacking room for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved trailer staging/drop yards inside the gate before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Two large dedicated trailer drop yards on the north side of the plant - a central yard (rows of ~60+ mixed-color trailers) and an east yard (rows of ~50+ trailers), separate from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ - the combined north drop yards hold well over 100 parked trailers.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors with trailers backed in along the east face of the engine plant building; estimated ~35 doors (25-50 band). Count is approximate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide truck-gate apron and wide internal roads leave clear room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single main engine-plant building (plus minor support structures) - not a multi-building campus, so multipleFacilities false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the plant sits on a greenfield industrial parcel north of Huntsville surrounded by farmland; a large solar farm occupies adjacent land to the east.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~275 acres fenced plant footprint (excludes the adjacent solar farm).
fieldNotes._note: TMMAL is the Toyota engine plant (V6/V8 engines), distinct from the nearby Mazda-Toyota JV assembly plant (idx 6). The two are separate Huntsville-area Toyota facilities.

citations.claim: TMMAL Huntsville engine plant; only plant building 4-cyl, V6, V8 under one roof; 1,500+ team, 3,000+ engines/day
Toyota Alabama engine plant produced over 895,000 engines in 2024, a new record

verification.rationale: Operational engine plant (distinct from MTMUS assembly JV); record 2024 output + ongoing investment; no negative.
